description: The "accessory_addon_trailer_cables_data" unit class is used for adding dynamic trailer cables between a vehicle and its trailer. For player trucks, units of this type are usually defined in "/def/vehicle/truck/<brand.model>/accessory/trlr_cables/*.sii" and valid unit names end in ".trlr_cables". For player trailers, units of this type are usually defined in "/def/vehicle/trailer/<trailer_name>/accessory/trlr_cables/*.sii" and valid unit names end in ".trlr_cables".
versionNote: This unit type was added in 1.31.

cables.description: Each member points to a trailer_cable_data unit
